settings.title: Daum Postcode Settings
settings.description: Configure the display mode and style of Daum Postcode service.
settings.notice: Daum Postcode service is free to use without API key.

guide.title: Usage Guide
guide.step1: Choose the display mode separately for PC and for mobile (phones and tablets). Inline expands the search right below the address field, Layer overlays the current page, Popup opens a new window, and Fullscreen opens a window covering the whole screen.
guide.step2: If you chose layer or popup for PC, set the search window size. A layer larger than the screen shrinks to fit.
guide.step3: Customize the postcode search window style by setting the theme color.

display_mode_pc.label: Display Mode (PC)
display_mode_pc.hint: How the address search opens on PC (screen width 1024px or more).

display_mode_mobile.label: Display Mode (Mobile)
display_mode_mobile.hint: How the address search opens on phones and tablets (screen width 1023px or less).

popup_width.label: PC Layer/Popup Width (px)
popup_width.hint: Window width used by the layer and popup modes on PC. A layer larger than the screen shrinks to fit. (100–2000)

popup_height.label: PC Layer/Popup Height (px)
popup_height.hint: Window height used by the layer and popup modes on PC. A layer larger than the screen shrinks to fit. (100–2000)

theme_color.label: Theme Color
theme_color.hint: Theme color for the postcode search window. (e.g., #1D4ED8)
